definition.name: Heating assembly
definition.description: A resistance heater; variants show immersion, mat, storage and staged heater forms.

terminals.label: L
terminals.purpose: Line conductor: the alternating supply relative to neutral.

terminals.label: N
terminals.purpose: Neutral: the normal return path. It is not a protective conductor.

terminals.label: PE
terminals.purpose: Protective connection to the represented exposed conductive parts or protective network. It carries no intended normal load return and remains independent of switching the active conductors.

parts.name: Housing
parts.purpose: The enclosure supports and separates functional parts. This original teaching model is representative equipment, not a manufacturer drawing.

parts.name: Removable cover
parts.purpose: The cover limits access to internal connections. Opening it here is a virtual inspection operation.

parts.name: Terminal clamps
parts.purpose: Metal clamps establish connections to individual conductors. The circuit engine connects terminal IDs, not the apparent proximity of 3D wires.

parts.name: Mounting and fixings
parts.purpose: Mounting hardware supports the equipment. Screws, rail clips and glands are modelled separately from electrical connections.

parts.name: Heating element
parts.purpose: Electrical resistance converts power to heat. For a fixed resistance, power changes with the square of voltage.

parts.name: Thermal protection
parts.purpose: A thermal element responds to heating or sustained excess current. Timing is illustrative here; it is not a manufacturer trip curve.
